title: THE RAID LABELS GROW AT 4K
why: Seen on the 4K raid screenshot of 2026-10-08: the hiding chip above the weapon panel (CONCEALED, IN COVER and the rest) and the label on an extraction ring (EXTRACTION POINT - SOUND THE ALARM TO BEGIN COUNTDOWN) stayed their 1080p size on a 4K screen, tiny beside the panel and the world around them. Both now grow with the screen; at 1080p nothing changes.
now: At 4K the hiding chip and the ring labels are readable from the couch.
